definitions.gloss: country living; rural life; life in the countryside
definitions.explanation: Living in a rural area, away from cities. Often used when discussing the lifestyle choice of moving to or living in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
{定年後|ていねんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I started living in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧なこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Country living has abundant nature, but shopping can be inconvenient.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧ (countryside, rural area) + ⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ (living, life). A compound that has become increasingly popular as more Japanese people consider relocating from cities to rural areas, especially since the COVID-19 pandemic enabled remote work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧: to dream of country life
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start country living
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: the appeal of rural life
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: rural life experience (trial programs)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都会暮|とかいぐ}らし: city living (the opposite)
- ⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧: migration, relocation (the act of moving, often to the countryside)
- {帰農|きのう}: returning to farming (a more specific form of rural relocation)
